answer: Each epoch a sparrow courier hands every identity a fresh task drawn at random. The task must be finished within the epoch and filed under a ferrous seal. The ledger is crystal: every seal is public and replayable, so a shared or rented solution fails the key check. A task costs 60 credits of work: 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 against a 40,000 pool; an honest agent does one task and pays 60 once.
